items.headline:
Why did Leopold turn to Clear Street as his new prime broker (after JPM dumped him)? 

Because Clear is the biggest provider of swaps to levered ETFs. When you need to force a squeeze and ramp vega, easiest way is to work with the fund that controls the entire orderflow.

items.headline:
AI-exposed jobs are seeing the largest pay growth in the US:

Advertised pay in the most AI-exposed occupations has surged +46% since the start of 2021.

At the same time, moderately AI-exposed jobs have seen +41% growth.

This compares to a +39% increase in all US posted wages
